notes: F-STD-020 / STD-9.1 / STD-9.9: every text operation returns an owned `String`-based value, so `lines()` yields `Vec<String>` and cannot be used as `usize`. The original example (`for line in text.lines()` on `&str`) was unreachable: stdlib.md §9 defines `lines()` on `&str`, so the call itself is legal and the mandated mismatch never occurs.
